decisions.reason: It is a consumer product outside the firm's core industrial technology portfolio and lacks continued web presence, indicating its option value has not been realized.
As an extension of the core waste-to-energy business, it has low keeping costs and still unresolved upside, so the option remains open.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant is central to the firm's sustainable technology portfolio and showed a quantified launch, so it is kept as a valuable option.
Although plastic waste-to-fuel involves more regulatory and technical uncertainty, its proximity to the core business and potential value justify keeping the option open.
